All: Defaults to system Company records plus values already in the ledger.
全部: 留空时自动使用系统 Company 主数据 + 台账里已有的值。

All: Defaults to system Department records plus values already in the ledger.
全部: 留空时自动使用系统 Department 主数据 + 台账里已有的值。

All: Each row pairs a department with its company. Leave empty to derive from system Department records and the ledger.
全部: 每行填「子公司 + 部门」。留空时自动取系统 Department.company 和台账里成对出现的值。

All: Explicit corporation scope for the budget ledger.
全部: 明确预算台账所属的 OA 企业范围。

All: Budget synchronization is not configured. Open Sync Settings.
全部: 预算同步尚未配置，请打开“同步设置”完成配置。

All: The configured source differs from the ledger source. Ask an administrator to review it.
全部: 当前数据源与台账原来源不一致，请管理员核对。

All: Settings changed after this task was queued. Start synchronization again.
全部: 任务入队后设置发生变化，请重新发起同步。

All: Budget synchronization is running. Try again after it finishes.
全部: 预算同步正在运行，请结束后再修改设置。

All: Enter a valid OA corporation ID.
全部: 请输入有效的 OA 企业 ID。

All: Complete the corporation scope and server connection before enabling synchronization.
全部: 请先配置企业范围和服务器连接，再启用同步。

All: The ledger contains data. Its corporation and database cannot be changed here.
全部: 台账已有数据，不能在此直接切换企业或数据库。

All: The ledger source fingerprint is managed by synchronization.
全部: 台账来源指纹由同步程序维护。

All: Budget sync settings changed. Reopen the settings and try again.
全部: 预算同步设置已被修改，请重新打开设置后重试。

All: The last synchronization failed. Existing ledger data was retained. Open the sync log for details.
全部: 上次同步失败，原有台账数据已保留，请查看同步日志。

All: Saving settings does not start synchronization. Database credentials are managed on the server and are never returned to this page.
全部: 保存设置不会立即同步。数据库连接凭据由服务器管理，不会返回到此页面。

All: Controls manual and scheduled budget ledger synchronization.
全部: 控制预算台账的手动同步和定时同步。
共享 OA 数据库连接

All: Reuse a server connection. Its configuration is checked when settings are saved.
全部: 复用服务器上已有的连接配置，保存时会检查配置是否完整。

All: Could not save settings. Your inputs have been retained.
全部: 设置保存失败，当前输入已保留。

All: Could not queue synchronization. Check the status before retrying.
全部: 同步任务提交失败，请核对状态后重试。

All: Could not load synchronization status. Refresh to retry.
全部: 同步状态加载失败，请刷新重试。

All: Budget data is synchronized through Synchronize Data.
全部: 可通过“同步数据”更新预算台账。

All: Organization options are unavailable. Existing ledger filters are being used.
全部: 组织选项暂不可用，已使用现有台账筛选项。

All: No eligible budget approvals were found. Existing ledger data was retained.
全部: 没有符合条件的预算审批，已保留现有台账数据。

All: The expense source does not match the budget source. Expense amounts and balances are unavailable until the source binding is reviewed.
全部: 支出数据来源与预算来源不一致，请核对来源绑定；当前不显示支出金额及余额。
